_comment: This list MUST match the Shopify 'platform' metaobject entries character for character (handles and display names).
The validator checks vehicle-map.json against this file. Reading the live list from Shopify instead is deferred to Phase 4+ (no API code in the repo yet).
When a platform is added, split, or renamed: change it here AND in Shopify in the same piece of work, on a branch, and run  npm run validate-fitment  before committing.
Sub-generations (ADR-003) are ordinary entries named <parent>-<qualifier>. There is no parent/child structure — every entry is a peer with its own page.
Last verified against Shopify (read-only, via the connector): 2026-09-20.
